Glance 2026.09.23.1 expands CLI preview control and adds a per-window text monitoring switch.

- Preview standard input with `preview -`, including original binary data with `--raw` and a filename hint with `--name`.
- Address windows by UUID, switch their files with `window set`, and control text lines, document pages, gallery navigation, and media playback.
- Receive complete window information after loading. Use `--timeout` to bound waiting and `--wait` to wait for the window to close.
- Fix CLI window resizing and unpinning, and refresh command help and the bilingual [CLI guide](https://github.com/ElluIFX/Glance/blob/v2026.09.23.1/docs/CLI.en.md).
- Toggle file monitoring from the plain-text preview status bar. Updates are checked every second; right-click the button to refresh once.
- Copy the quoted CLI executable path from Settings > Maintenance, and show the administrator repair action only when needed.
